papers.title: Osseointegration Enhancement by Zr doping of Co-Cr-Mo Implants Fabricated by Electron Beam Melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: BIOMATCELL Vinn Excellence Center of Biomaterials and Cell Therapy, Göteborg, Sweden

corresponding_authors.name: Anders Palmquist
corresponding_authors.affiliation: BIOMATCELL Vinn Excellence Center of Biomaterials and Cell Therapy, Göteborg, Sweden

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了EBM制造的Co-Cr-Mo植入物的骨整合增强，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳或LPBF工艺。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses electron beam melting (EBM) not LPBF, focuses on Zr doping for osseointegration but does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or porous structure design.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过Zr掺杂增强Co-Cr-Mo植入物的骨整合性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用电子束熔化制备不同Zr含量的Co-Cr-Mo合金，并进行体外细胞实验。
summary_zh.result: Zr掺杂显著提高了成骨细胞活性和骨整合能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞培养和表面分析验证骨整合效果。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance osseointegration of Co-Cr-Mo implants by incorporating Zr doping.
summary_en.method: Co-Cr-Mo alloys with varying Zr content were fabricated via electron beam melting and evaluated through in vitro cell assays.
summary_en.result: Zr doping significantly improved osteoblast activity and osseointegration potential.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture and surface characterization were used to validate osseointegration enhancement.

papers.title: A second generation constrained acetabular component for treatment of complex hip replacement instability
papers.abstract: Background: Hip instability can be anticipated in rare cases of primary hip replacement and is a common cause of failed total hip arthroplasty (THA). One approach to hip instability is THA using a constrained acetabular component. Methods: Twenty THAs were performed in 18 patients. A constrained acetabular liner (Trilogy® Longevity®, Zimmer Inc. Warsaw, IN) was implanted to treat anticipated or prior hip instability. Results: At an average of 28.1 mo, none of the patients had experienced a dislocation of the constrained implant. Conclusions: The Trilogy® constrained acetabular liner is a viable option to treat patients with recurrent dislocations or complex hip instability.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注髋关节置换术后不稳定的临床治疗，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动等生物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical case series on constrained acetabular liners for hip instability, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no FEA, and no implant design or validation relevant to femoral stem mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估约束型髋臼杯治疗髋关节置换术后不稳定的效果
summary_zh.method: 对18例患者20例THA植入约束型内衬，随访平均28.1个月
summary_zh.result: 无一例发生脱位，约束型内衬是可行的治疗选择

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical efficacy of a constrained acetabular liner in treating hip instability after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Twenty THAs in 18 patients received a Trilogy Longevity constrained liner and were followed for an average of 28.1 months.
summary_en.result: No dislocations occurred during follow-up, indicating the constrained liner is a viable option for recurrent instability.

papers.title: Global sensitivity analysis in hydrological modeling: Review of concepts, methods, theoretical framework, and applications
papers.abstract: Sensitivity analysis (SA) aims to identify the key parameters that affect model performance and it plays important roles in model parameterization, calibration, optimization, and uncertainty quantification. However, the increasing complexity of hydrological models means that a large number of parameters need to be estimated. To better understand how these complex models work, efficient SA methods should be applied before the application of hydrological modeling. This study provides a comprehensive review of global SA methods in the field of hydrological modeling. The common definitions of SA and the typical categories of SA methods are described. A wide variety of global SA methods have been introduced to provide a more efficient evaluation framework for hydrological modeling. We review, analyze, and categorize research into global SA methods and their applications, with an emphasis on the research accomplished in the hydrological modeling field. The advantages and disadvantages are also discussed and summarized. An application framework and the typical practical steps involved in SA for hydrological modeling are outlined. Further discussions cover several important and often overlooked topics, including the relationship between parameter identification, uncertainty analysis, and optimization in hydrological modeling, how to deal with correlated parameters, and time-varying SA. Finally, some conclusions and guidance recommendations on SA in hydrological modeling are provided, as well as a list of important future research directions that may facilitate more robust analyses when assessing hydrological modeling performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述水文模型中全局敏感性分析方法以改进参数化与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾并分类全局SA方法，讨论其优缺点及应用框架。
summary_zh.result: 总结了SA在水文建模中的实践步骤与未来研究方向。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为纯综述论文。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a comprehensive review of global sensitivity analysis methods for improving parameterization and uncertainty quantification in hydrological modeling.
summary_en.method: A systematic review categorizing global SA methods, discussing their advantages, disadvantages, and application frameworks.
summary_en.result: Summarized practical steps and future research directions for SA in hydrological modeling.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a pure review paper.
